Apgar scores of 8, 8, and 10 at 1, 5, and 10 minutes
serum creatinine was elevated at 156.1 µmol/L
mixed long and short T1 and T2 signals with internal light bands
bilateral ureteral dilation, and urinary retention

Apgar scores of 8, 8, and 10 at 1, 5, and 10 minutes
serum creatinine was elevated at 156.1 µmol/L
mixed long and short T1 and T2 signals with internal light bands
bilateral ureteral dilation, and urinary retention

concepts.why: The presence of a markedly dilated fetal bladder, bladder wall irregularity and thickening, and bilateral ureteral dilation with urinary retention are indicative of posterior urethral valves.
The combination of bilateral renal enlargement, hydronephrosis, and impaired renal function suggests renal dysplasia.
The presence of a markedly dilated fetal bladder, bladder wall irregularity and thickening, and bilateral ureteral dilation with urinary retention are indicative of urinary tract obstruction.
The presence of oligohydramnios and impaired renal function suggests a possible link between the two conditions.
The presence of bilateral renal enlargement and hydronephrosis suggests congenital hydronephrosis.
The combination of a markedly dilated fetal bladder, bladder wall irregularity and thickening, and bilateral ureteral dilation with urinary retention are indicative of prune belly syndrome.
The presence of impaired renal function and elevated serum creatinine suggests renal impairment.
The presence of bilateral renal enlargement and hydronephrosis, and bilateral ureteral dilation with urinary retention are indicative of ureteropelvic junction obstruction.
The mixed long and short T1 and T2 signals with internal light bands in the left perirenal collection on postnatal MRI explain the urinary retention and bladder wall irregularity.

rationales.F03: Bilateral renal enlargement and hydronephrosis are common in congenital hydronephrosis and renal dysplasia.
rationales.F04: A markedly dilated fetal bladder is a characteristic feature of posterior urethral valves.
rationales.F05: A left perirenal fluid collection may be associated with renal dysplasia or congenital hydronephrosis.
rationales.F08: Elevated serum creatinine indicates impaired renal function, which is a common feature of several renal disorders.
rationales.F11: Bladder wall irregularity and thickening are characteristic features of posterior urethral valves.
rationales.F12: Bilateral ureteral dilation and urinary retention are common in congenital hydronephrosis and posterior urethral valves.
